package.name: health_monitor_cpp
package.description:
Passive runtime health monitor for the BFMC autonomy stack. Subscribes to key topics across drivers, perception, fusion, and TF; publishes rate, latency, drop, and value statistics on /system/health/status and /system/health/metrics; optionally writes a YAML validation summary per launch run for race-day post-mortems.
Disabled by default; gated through the enable_runtime_validation launch argument in system_bringup. Pure C++, no perception path modifications, single-threaded executor.
